components.name: Primary Play Button
components.description: The canonical primary action — accent circle with a centered glyph, used for play across the app.
components.html: <button class="ds-play" aria-label="Play"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="22" height="22"><path d="M8 5v14l11-7z" fill="#000000"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-play { display:inline-grid; place-items:center; width:56px; height:56px; border:none; border-radius:999px; background:#1DB954; cursor:pointer; transition:transform .1s ease-in-out, background .2s; } .ds-play:hover { background:#3FCB6F; } .ds-play:active { transform:scale(.97); } .ds-play:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #1DB954; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Pill Button
components.description: Stadium primary action with accent fill and black ink.
components.css: .ds-pill { font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:14px; color:#000; background:#1DB954; border:none; border-radius:999px; padding:12px 32px; cursor:pointer; transition:transform .1s ease-in-out, background .2s; } .ds-pill:hover { background:#3FCB6F; } .ds-pill:active { transform:scale(.97); } .ds-pill:disabled { background:#158A3E; color:#7F7F7F; cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Genre / library facet filter. Selected state inverts to accent fill.
components.css: .ds-chips { display:flex; gap:8px; } .ds-chip { font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:500; font-size:13px; color:#fff; background:#282828; border:none; border-radius:999px; padding:6px 12px; cursor:pointer; transition:background .2s, transform .1s ease-in-out; } .ds-chip:active { transform:scale(.97); } .ds-chip--on { background:#1DB954; color:#000; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #1DB954; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Album Card
components.description: Library grid tile — large cover, title, subtitle. The atmosphere starts here.

components.css: .ds-album { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px; width:160px; padding:12px; border-radius:16px; background:#121212; cursor:pointer; transition:background .2s, transform .1s ease-in-out; } .ds-album:hover { background:#181818; } .ds-album:active { transform:scale(.98); } .ds-album__art { aspect-ratio:1; border-radius:12px; background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1A1A2E,#533483); } .ds-album__title { font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:16px; color:#fff; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; } .ds-album__sub { font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:12px; color:#B3B3B3; }

components.name: Progress Slider
components.description: Now Playing scrubber — SliderTheme+Slider only, matched to the mini player. Custom painters forbidden.
components.css: .ds-slider { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:6px; } .ds-slider__track { position:relative; height:4px; border-radius:999px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.1); } .ds-slider__fill { position:absolute; inset:0 65% 0 0; border-radius:999px; background:#1DB954; } .ds-slider__thumb { position:absolute; left:35%; top:50%; width:12px; height:12px; border-radius:999px; background:#fff; transform:translate(-50%,-50%); box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.4); } .ds-slider__times { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:12px; color:#7F7F7F; }

components.name: Bottom Navigation
components.description: Flat bottom nav over bg-base, zero elevation. Accent marks the selected destination.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; justify-content:space-around; background:#000; padding:8px 0; } .ds-nav__item { display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:4px; background:none; border:none; cursor:pointer; color:#7F7F7F; font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:500; font-size:11px; transition:color .15s; } .ds-nav__item span { letter-spacing:.2px; } .ds-nav__item--on { color:#1DB954; } .ds-nav__item:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #1DB954; outline-offset:2px; border-radius:6px; }

narrative.overview: The cover is the light source. NaviVibe extracts a four-color palette from each album's artwork (PaletteCache) and lets it breathe behind Now Playing through a custom fluid fragment shader. The interface dissolves into the song's own world — covers, titles, and playback affordances lead; chrome recedes. This atmosphere is delivered through six fully-committed themes (Spotify, Aura, Frost, Neumorphic, Analog, Zen) that re-skin the entire surface, held together by one discipline: every widget reads ThemeTokens.of(context) and never hardcodes a color. The system rejects hardcoded brand colors, overloaded nested cards, and AI-scaffolding. A private library elevated to commercial-streaming polish — not a SaaS dashboard wearing a music skin.
keyCharacteristics: Theme-agnostic by contract — all color/type flows through ThemeTokens.of(context).
Cover-first hierarchy — album art drives both layout focus and the live palette.
Atmospheric depth — fluid shaders and album-derived color, not flat fills, behind playback.
Tactile, restrained motion — press-scale feedback, 150-250ms state transitions, easeOutCubic.
Dense but breathable — library and queue carry many rows; spacing rhythm keeps them legible.

rules.name: The Themability Rule
rules.body: Every color comes from ThemeTokens.of(context). Hardcoding any hex in a widget is forbidden. A color the tokens don't expose means a new token on AppThemeTokens applied to all six themes — never a literal.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: The accent marks primary action, current selection, and live state. Forbidden as decoration, gradient fill, or divider. Its scarcity is what makes a playing track read instantly.

rules.name: The No-Cross-Bleed Rule
rules.body: A theme's identity is total. Spotify green on Analog, Aura purple on Zen, glass on Neumorphic are all prohibited. If a screen looks the same across two themes, the screen is wrong.

rules.name: The Fixed-Scale Rule
rules.body: Type sizes are fixed px, not clamp(). A title that shrinks inside a sidebar or mini-player looks broken, not responsive.

rules.name: The One-Face-Per-Theme Rule
rules.body: Each theme uses a single family across all weights. Contrast comes from weight (400/600/700), not from mixing families.

rules.name: The Tonal-First Rule
rules.body: On dark themes, depth is lightness, not shadow. Reach for bgElevated/bgOverlay before a BoxShadow. Shadows belong to Neumorphic and Frost only.

rules.name: The Pressed-State Rule
rules.body: State must be felt, not just colored — neumorphic surfaces invert their shadow, tappable elements scale to 0.97.

dos: Do read every color, text style, and radius from ThemeTokens.of(context); a new color means a new token applied to all six themes.
Do lead every layout with cover art, then title, then artist, then playback affordances.
Do drive Now Playing atmosphere from the album-derived PaletteCache palette and the fluid shader.
Do keep state transitions 150-250ms on easeOutCubic/easeOut; respect MediaQuery.disableAnimations and prefers-reduced-motion.
Do express touch physically — CupertinoClickable press-scale, NeuBox shadow inversion.
Do hold body and placeholder text at >=4.5:1 contrast; use textSecondary for placeholders, never textMuted.
Do use SliderTheme + Slider for the Now Playing progress bar, matching the mini player.
donts: Don't hardcode colors. No generic green/blue gradients, no Spotify-green override on a non-Spotify theme.
Don't let a theme's identity bleed into another — Aura purple on Zen, glass on Neumorphic, green on Analog.
Don't overload screens with nested cards or generic decorative borders.
Don't add fake eyebrows, numbered section markers, or generic marketing copy that carries no information.
Don't use a border-left/border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe.
Don't use the accent as decoration, a card-fill gradient, or a divider — primary action, selection, and live state only.
Don't replace the progress bar with _NeonTrackPainter or _GlassThumbShape, and don't import shadows into the flat dark themes.
Don't use fluid clamp() type scales; the px scale is fixed for product-UI consistency.
